## Price

`amount` (AmountWithCurrency), `billingInterval` (one-time/monthly/annual), links to exactly one of `plan`/`service`. Kept separate from both so a Plan can carry monthly AND annual price points without duplicating the Plan. The one-of-two-links invariant is enforced at the command layer, not the schema, matching this realm's existing convention of guarding invariants in commands rather than field validators.

### Non-goals
Does not itself appear on a Quote's line items — Price is the catalog/lookup entity used to populate a line item at authoring time, not the line item's own storage shape.

### Example
`linkedExamples` points at `Price/enterprise-tier-annual`, linked to the real `Plan/enterprise-tier` instance, priced to match `Deal/acme-enterprise-renewal`'s actual $58,000 value.
attributes.cardDescription: A specific amount + currency + billing interval for a Plan or a Service.
